name: Sanathan Textiles Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 2005, Sanathan Textiles 
Ltd manufactures and exports polyester 
yarn, cotton yarn and yarn for technical
textile[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
Sanathan Textiles Limited is one of India’s leading yarn manufacturers, operating across three key segments: Polyester Filament Yarn, Cotton Yarn, and Yarns for Technical Textiles. Backed by over 140+ years of cumulative promoter experience in the textile industry, the company employs more than 3,000 people.

cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has a low return on equity of 11.5% over last 3 years.
Company might be capitalizing the interest cost
